stories.story_fr: Coinbase a lance l Everything Exchange, sa nouvelle plateforme unifiee, et l a etendue au T3 2025 en augmentant le nombre d actifs spot negociables (couverture d environ 90% de la capitalisation crypto totale) et en elargissant l offre de derives.
stories.story_en: Coinbase launched the Everything Exchange and made progress in Q3 2025 by increasing the number of tradable spot assets, now covering approximately 90% of total crypto market cap, and expanding its derivatives offering.
stories.signal: We successfully launched the Everything Exchange to the delight of our customers, drove growth and diversification of revenue, and extended our multi-year track record of profitability .

stories.story_fr: Le T3 2025 a vu la cloture de l acquisition de Deribit, le lancement des perpetuels US et du trading de futures 24/7, portant l activite derives a un plus haut historique de part de marche sur plusieurs marches dont les futures crypto US et les options crypto mondiales.
stories.story_en: Q3 2025 saw the close of the Deribit acquisition, the launch of U.S. perpetuals and 24/7 futures trading, driving the derivatives business to an all-time high market share across several markets including U.S. crypto futures and global crypto options.
stories.signal: Our derivatives business reached an all-time high share across several markets, including U.S. crypto futures and global crypto options, with the launch of U.S. perpetuals and 24 7 futures trading, and the close of the Deribit acquisition .

stories.story_fr: Coinbase accelere les paiements via l adoption du stablecoin USDC, qui a atteint un plus haut historique de 74 Mds $ de capitalisation au T3 2025, soutenu par l adoption des institutions financieres et des entreprises pour leurs besoins de paiement et de tresorerie.
stories.story_en: Coinbase is accelerating payments through USDC stablecoin adoption, which reached an all-time high of $74 billion market cap in Q3 2025, supported by adoption from financial institutions and corporates for payment and treasury needs.
stories.signal: We are accelerating payments through stablecoin adoption , which we anticipate will continue given policy tailwinds, and ongoing adoption from financial institutions and corporates for payment and treasury needs.
